## Aetherbound — Shards of Dawn

A self-contained Three.js third-person action adventure. Cross four connected
realms — Sunlit Meadow, Ancient Ruins, Crystal Caverns and Skybound Isles —
gather 32 dawn shards, and defeat the four wardens who seal the road to dawn.

### Play

Serve the repository root over HTTP and open the page:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
# then open http://localhost:3002
```

Three.js and the fonts load from CDNs, so an internet connection is required.

### Controls

| Action | Keyboard / mouse |
| --- | --- |
| Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` |
| Look | Mouse (click to capture) |
| Jump / double jump | `Space` |
| Dash | `Shift` |
| Attack combo | `J` / left click |
| Lock on | `Q` |
| Interact / travel | `E` |
| Pause | `Esc` |
| Mute | `M` |

Gamepad and touch controls are also supported.

### Progress

Each realm's warden guards the exit. Defeating a warden opens the gate or portal
to the next realm. Checkpoints restore health and set your respawn point; the
journey autosaves every few seconds and whenever progress changes.

### Bugs list

1. Gamepad Y triggers jump due to `buttons[3]` in jump check. Should remove 3. Also `isDown('interact')` not implemented for gamepad, but interact uses consumePressed so fine.

2. `input.update(dt)` never called, so gamepad polling and camera axes don't work. Add `if (this.input) this.input.update(dt);` in loop before update. This is important for gamepad support claim. Also gamepad look poll only happens in update. Add.

3. `Input` keydown handler: `if (action === 'mute' || action === 'pause') this.pressed.add(action);` duplicates inside `if (!e.repeat)` block; harmless. But pause key pressed while playing triggers global hotkey at end of loop. And Escape window listener also calls pause() directly, then input.consumePressed('pause') may call pause again no-op. Fine.
